data.summary:
**When:** [Opponent's Shooting phase](vsdata:core-rule/shooting-phase), after a **NECRONS** unit of yours is **destroyed** by an enemy unit.

**Target:** A **NECRONS CHARACTER** unit of yours that was up to 6" from that **NECRONS** unit at the moment it was **destroyed**.

**Effect:** Once the enemy unit finishes its attacks, the unit can shoot as though in [your Shooting phase](vsdata:core-rule/shooting-phase), if it can target that enemy unit, and only at that enemy unit.
